alate: Head of the alate broadly oval, the postclypeus very short and flat, antennae 18–25 segments. Pronotum flattened, narrower than the head. Forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale and covering its posterior margin; the wing veins with a very faint reticulate pattern, the wing surface hairy; the media of the forewing arising independently at the humeral suture, that of the hindwing arising from the base of the radial sector, the media very close to the cubitus. Fontanelle situated at the middle of the head.
soldier: Head of the soldier oval, distinctly narrowed anteriorly, the fontanelle a large aperture situated at the front of the head and extended forwards on a short tube. Mandibles slender and curved, the inner margin smooth and toothless apart from the saw-like incision at the base. Antennae 13–17 segments; labrum a pointed tongue. Pronotum flat, narrower than the head. Surface of the postmentum spherically swollen, the narrowest part near the posterior end. With 17 antennal segments the second and fourth are subequal and both shorter than the third. Pronotum rather broad, wider than the mesonotum; the middle of the anterior margin slightly projecting forwards with a small shallow depression at the centre, the middle of the posterior margin likewise concave, the notch both shallow and broad. Legs rather slender and long, tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.
